t: How Plan B Works | Plan B One-Step®
s: Where to Buy · Play · So let’s start with the facts. Plan B is safe and effective emergency contraception. It is not an abortion pill and will not harm an existing pregnancy. Plan B must be taken within 72 hours after one incident of unprotected sex (i.e., the condom breaking or missing a birth control pill).
